title: Passenger traffic at Calapan Port increases as Undas travelers return to Batangas, Manila
summary: Passenger traffic began increasing at Calapan Port in Oriental Mindoro on Tuesday as travelers headed back to Batangas and Manila after spending the Undas holidays in their home provinces.
